name: Sliced Prosciutto, Coppa & Soppressata Charcuterie Plate (Captain's Gala Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced prosciutto and aged Parmigiano chunks are low-residue, while soppressata contains whole black peppercorns and higher cured fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the thin prosciutto and aged cheese with white rolls; skip the peppercorn-studded soppressata, olives, and pickled peppers.
